const sym = Symbol('k');
function expectName<N>() {
  return (_v: any, c: ClassMethodDecoratorContext & { name: N }) => {
    console.log('key', typeof c.name === 'symbol' ? c.name.description : c.name);
  };
}
function log<T extends Function>(target: T, context: ClassMethodDecoratorContext) {
  console.log('wrapped', String(context.name));
  return target;
}
function bound<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(target: T, context: ClassMethodDecoratorContext) {
  return target;
}
class Calc {
  @log add(a: number, b: number) {
    return a + b;
  }
  @bound twice(a: number) {
    return a * 2;
  }
  @expectName<'quoted'>() 'quoted'() {}
  @expectName<'2'>() [2]() {}
  @expectName<typeof sym>() [sym]() {}
}
console.log(new Calc().add(1, 2), new Calc().twice(4));
